Example they flagged: Dana Whitfield's design validation report (the draft v3 document) is not anywhere in the new export. The custodian holds for this matter have been in place since June; this should not be possible. Please get the custodians' data back to the state it was in when the holds were applied, and get to the bottom of how this happened. -- Imelda Reyes, Legal Ops
